posts.name: broccoli
posts.cooked:
Just got both Golem Unity and Engine of War Bunker in the same game.  Team was:

Argent Adept, (normal) Bunker, Omnitron-X, Unity vs. Baron Blade in the Block

Based on some stuff from the Steam forums, I thought that Bunker dying in the Block (where Fright Train is seen) was a good idea.  I thought that Prison Riot might be a necessary component, but I never saw it, so I guess it isn't.

 

I basically used AA and O-X to give Unity tons of card plays while Bunker used Grenade Launcher on various targets and stacked up the Omni-Cannon.  Once Unity had a fleet of bots, I had Bunker Omni-Cannon himself and then I let Unity's bots start hitting herself to get her down to 6.  Raptor bot won the game with a hit for 12 against the Baron.

I started using O-X on The Block to try for Prison Riot, but never saw it (or apparently needed it).

Prior to this game (based on advice from both forums) I lost 2 games against Iron Legacy using various Freedom Six team comps.

posts.name: Kerredai
posts.cooked:
That's not quite enough -- I've just beaten Blade in the Block with Bunker incapped, and saw Flak Cannon, Omni-Cannon, Prison Riot and the Warden, with no unlock. (Legacy, Bunker, Argent Adept, Tempest, Rook City Wraith)

Folks on the Steam forums are speculating that there needs to be a Shattered Timelines hero present, so I tried the same setup but with Chrono-Ranger instead of Argent Adept -- still no unlock.

Tried the same setup again, but with Omnitron-X -- still no dice. 

Tried again after having Blade incapacitate Young Legacy in the Mars Base, still nothing.

 

So, the following isn't sufficient (though may be necessary)

*Absolute Zero, Bunker, Tachyon, Tempest, Unity, and Wraith all previously defeated by Iron Legacy

*Young Legacy has previously been incapacitated by Baron Blade in the Wagner Mars Base

*Bunker incapacitated in the Block, against Baron Blade 

---With Chrono-Ranger present

---With Omnitron-X present

*Prison Riot was played

*Warden Hoeffle was played

*Baron Blade then defeated
